findings.evidence: Grep for `isCompact_preimage'` returns 12 hits in this file, at lines 96, 106, 113, 138, 175, 181, 273, 280, 284, 288, 294 and 379; line 96 contains two copies. `mathlib/Mathlib/Topology/Sets/Compacts.lean` builds the preimage only inline, inside `range_map` (line 232), not as a named definition.
findings.fix: Add one private `def preimageCompacts (W : Opens Mₜ) (K : Compacts Mₜ) (hKW : (K : Set Mₜ) ⊆ W) : Compacts ((Opens.toTopCat Mₜ).obj W)`. Use `(preimageCompacts W K hKW).isCompact` at every occurrence above. This is a local helper; Mathlib has no `Compacts` preimage constructor to reuse.
findings.issue: The term `W.isOpenEmbedding.isInducing.isCompact_preimage' K.isCompact (by rwa [Opens.set_range_inclusion'])` is pasted 13 times: lines 96, 106, 113, 138, 175, 181, 273, 280, 284, 288, 294 and 379 (with `(K ⊓ N)`). The `Compacts` structure `⟨Opens.inclusion' W ⁻¹' K, …⟩` is also rebuilt in three statement signatures and two `let NW` blocks. Proof bodies and statements are bloated, and any change to this reasoning has to be made in every copy.

findings.evidence: Line 381: `have hN := (Set.image_preimage_eq_of_subset (f := Opens.inclusion' W) (s := ((K ⊓ N : Compacts Mₜ) : Set Mₜ)) (by rwa [Opens.set_range_inclusion'])).symm.subset`, which only needs the subset fact `hKW`. `fundamentalClassOn_open_preimage` builds the same term as `hKI`.
findings.fix: Remove the `hN` parameter. Derive it once, next to the factored `preimageCompacts`, as a private lemma `subset_map_preimageCompacts`, and use that lemma in the two statements and at both rebuild sites.
findings.issue: `support_excision_preimage` (line 173) and `duality_excision_preimage` (line 271) take `hN : K ⊆ (NW.map …)` as a hypothesis, but it follows from `hKW`. The caller rebuilds it at line 381 with `(Set.image_preimage_eq_of_subset …).symm.subset`, and `fundamentalClassOn_open_preimage` rebuilds the same term as `hKI`.

summary: The earlier convert-built data and the uncommented rfl/convert closures are fixed. Cap/MayerVietoris.lean still pastes the same compact-preimage proof term 13 times, and two lemmas take an `hN` hypothesis that follows from `hKW`.
